last_sync_note: Session 1, Turn 3 is resolved at the Three Lanterns Inn. DevilMedlar trusted Senpai to lead the questioning of Seraphine Vale while protecting the pair's private information. Senpai remained calm, succeeded on Deception 21 and Insight 15, and learned that Seraphine is funded by the Meridian Archive, suspects an internal leak of protected ruin locations, and has a direct stake in the missing Copper Finch Courier because a sealed Archive dispatch case containing copies of her field notes was aboard it. Seraphine identified Suncoil Watch east of Cinderwash Turnoff and said the dragon-sun motif predates Clan Aurivane, though some Aurivane radial design may derive from the same older tradition. No quest, map transfer, lodging, or new agreement has been accepted. Both characters remain at 80 / 300 XP.
